title: Olivia Dean’s song hit with lawsuit claiming it was copied from Bill Withers’s ‘Just the Two of Us’
summary: British pop star Olivia Dean is facing allegations that her song 'I’ve Seen It' copied the melody of Bill Withers’s classic 'Just the Two of Us.'
